name: ImportLogicalFingerprintAndReplay
fingerprint_input: for every logical matrix row: identity classification token, canonical identities when valid, canonical field keys, field class/value-state/value-kind and validated normalized value or deterministic validation token
duplicate/conflict classification tokens needed to reproduce exact source disposition
deterministic finding semantics needed to reproduce the processed logical disposition; operator message wording, timestamps and physical locators remain excluded
excluded: raw XLSX/ZIP bytes and package ordering
worksheet/row/column physical ordering except bounded row locator retained separately as provenance

source_row_chronology_utc as a separate scalar; when chronology is a registered semantic field its normalized field value already participates, while WFM candidate chronology must remain excluded so newer-identical content can compare equal
finding message_text/recorded_at_utc and generated persistence UUIDs

scalar_framing.length_prefix: exactly 8 unsigned big-endian bytes containing payload byte length

UTF8_TEXT.payload: strict UTF-8 bytes; no framing-time normalization because parser/profile normalization has already occurred

INTEGER_DECIMAL.payload: canonical nonnegative decimal ASCII: zero is exactly '0'; positive integers have no sign and no leading zeroes

scalar_framing.concatenation_rule: one scalar is tag byte + 8-byte length + payload; records and the final stream are exact concatenations of framed scalars with no separators, native-endian values, JSON, locale conversion or implicit terminators

validation_token.unknown_or_malformed_with_source_text: frame UTF8_TEXT literal SOURCE_TEXT_SHA256:<lowercase sha256 hex of the exact persisted bounded UTF-8 source_text bytes>
validation_token.rule: source_text itself is not inserted into the final logical stream; the deterministic token distinguishes materially different rejected/unknown allowlisted cell evidence without making packaging or generated persistence identity material

finding_frame.record: UTF8_TEXT FINDING_V1, finding_code, severity, scope_kind, then field_key as UTF8_TEXT or NULL
finding_frame.sort: finding_code UTF-8 bytes, severity UTF-8 bytes, scope_kind UTF-8 bytes, then NULL field_key before non-NULL field_key UTF-8 bytes
finding_frame.rule: duplicate/conflict findings are represented by row-variant classification tokens and therefore do not enter a row core twice

field_frame.record: UTF8_TEXT FIELD_V1, field_key, field_class, value_state, value_kind, vocabulary_id as UTF8_TEXT or NULL, then exactly one value/token scalar under validation_token
field_frame.field_logical_sha256: lowercase SHA-256 over the exact FIELD_V1 framed byte sequence; publication recomputes and requires equality with staged field_logical_sha256 before authority can publish

row_core_frame.record: UTF8_TEXT ROW_V1, identity_state, entity_kind, canonical_primary_id as UTF8_TEXT or NULL, canonical_parent_rfc_no as UTF8_TEXT or NULL, INTEGER_DECIMAL field_count, sorted FIELD_V1 frames, INTEGER_DECIMAL semantic_finding_count, sorted FINDING_V1 frames linked to this observation excluding duplicate/conflict classification findings
row_core_frame.row_logical_sha256: lowercase SHA-256 over the exact ROW_V1 framed byte sequence; publication recomputes and requires equality with staged row_logical_sha256 before authority can publish

duplicate_conflict_partition: valid rows group by entity_kind + canonical_primary_id + canonical_parent_rfc_no; rows with one distinct row hash produce UNIQUE when physical count=1 or EQUIVALENT_DUPLICATE when count>1

a valid identity group with more than one distinct row hash is a conflict; each distinct row-hash variant remains represented as CONFLICT_MEMBER with duplicate_count equal to that variant's physical occurrence count and conflict_variant_count equal to the number of distinct row hashes in the identity group
invalid rows have no canonical identity and group only by equal ROW_V1 hash; equal invalid variants may become EQUIVALENT_DUPLICATE but never identity conflict
generated duplicate/conflict finding rows do not alter ROW_V1 content after classification

final_stream.header: UTF8_TEXT SOMA_IMPORT_LOGICAL_V1, source_family, source_profile_id, header_registry_id, vocabulary_registry_id, parser_profile_id
final_stream.global_findings: INTEGER_DECIMAL count followed by sorted FINDING_V1 frames whose source_observation_id is NULL, excluding duplicate/conflict classification findings
final_stream.row_variants: INTEGER_DECIMAL effective row-variant count followed by each variant as UTF8_TEXT classification token (UNIQUE|EQUIVALENT_DUPLICATE|CONFLICT_MEMBER), INTEGER_DECIMAL duplicate_count, INTEGER_DECIMAL conflict_variant_count, then the complete ROW_V1 framed byte sequence
final_stream.sort: row variants ascending by identity_state rank invalid=0 valid=1, then NULL canonical_primary_id before UTF8_TEXT value, then NULL canonical_parent_rfc_no before UTF8_TEXT value, then lowercase row_logical_sha256 ASCII
final_stream.digest: SHA-256 over the one exact final byte stream yields lowercase 64-hex logical_fingerprint_sha256

canonicalization: exact equivalent duplicate rows collapse to one effective logical row variant plus deterministic duplicate_count/classification token while physical provenance remains stored separately
conflicting rows for one canonical identity remain separately represented by their distinct recomputed row logical hashes and CONFLICT_MEMBER tokens
invalid rows sort deterministically through their recomputed row hash, which includes semantic finding signatures rather than operator message text

no caller-supplied row/field hash, count or fingerprint is trusted at publication: the command rereads complete unpublished staging and recomputes field hashes, row hashes, duplicate/conflict partition, exact counts and final logical fingerprint

golden_vectors.description: one unique RFC row with one usable text field
unknown controlled Advanced Search value with deterministic validation token and finding

replay_decision: read current source-family checkpoint after staging fingerprint is known
if candidate chronology equals checkpoint chronology and fingerprint equals checkpoint fingerprint: EXACT_REPLAY_NOOP
if candidate chronology is newer and fingerprint equals checkpoint fingerprint: NEWER_IDENTICAL_NO_DOMAIN_CHANGE
if candidate chronology equals checkpoint chronology and fingerprint differs: CHRONOLOGY_CONTENT_CONFLICT
if candidate chronology is older: OLDER_SOURCE_RECOVERY_REQUIRED
if candidate chronology is newer and fingerprint differs: NEW_SOURCE
rules: exact replay generates no new domain observations/proposals/audit changes merely from reprocessing
newer identical content may update bounded check recency/checkpoint chronology in one technical command but creates no duplicate per-entity observations/proposals
equal chronology/different content and older source never auto-accept
logical fingerprint proves deterministic processed equality, not publisher authenticity or absence of human editing
